calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_period_label,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
JOIN fact_web_order wo ON f.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 35 AND 47
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_period_label,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN fact_web_order wo ON f.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 35 AND 47
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;
